result.summary: The page is generally polished, but several horizontally scrolling sections and the fixed bottom navigation create visible clipping and overlap.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second restaurant card, cutting off its image and hiding the card's remaining content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding to the scrollable page content so cards can scroll fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” carousel are visibly clipped at the right edge, showing partial chips and a partially visible restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels have intentional spacing and a clear scroll affordance, or adjust the layout so clipped items do not look accidentally cut off.

issues.description: The third restaurant name is truncated at the viewport edge (“Trattoria Piccol…”), making the content look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Keep carousel cards within a controlled horizontal scroller and reserve enough width for text, or truncate with a deliberate ellipsis inside the card boundary.
